text:
```yaml
name: Claude Automation on Mention
on:
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]
  pull_request_review_comment:
    types: [created]

jobs:
  claude-automation:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check for Claude mention
        id: check_mention
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const comment = context.payload.comment.body;
            const isMentioned = comment.toLowerCase().includes('@claude');
            
            if (isMentioned) {
              console.log('Claude mentioned in comment');
              return true;
            } else {
              console.log('No Claude mention found');
              return false;
            }
      
      - name: Trigger Claude Automation
        if: steps.check_mention.outputs.result == 'true'
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
        with:
          anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          claude_code_oauth_token: ${{ secrets.CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN }}
          trigger_phrase: "@claude"
          prompt: "Respond to the user's request based on the context of the issue or pull request comment."
          include_comments_by_actor: true
          exclude_comments_by_actor: false
          
      - name: Notify Slack on Success
        if: success()
        uses: ravsamhq/notify-slack-action@v2
        with:
          status: "success"
          token: ${{ secrets.SLACK_BOT_TOKEN }}
          notification_title: "Claude Automation Completed"
          message_format: "Claude automation triggered by @claude mention in ${{ github.event.issue.number || github.event.pull_request.number }} has completed successfully."
          mention_users: ""
          mention_groups: ""
          
      - name: Notify Slack on Failure
        if: failure()
        uses: ravsamhq/notify-slack-action@v2
        with:
          status: "failure"
          token: ${{ secrets.SLACK_BOT_TOKEN }}
          notification_title: "Claude Automation Failed"
          message_format: "Claude automation triggered by @claude mention in ${{ github.event.issue.number || github.event.pull_request.number }} has failed."
          mention_users: ""
          mention_groups: ""
```
